sections.html:
Paragould is the Greene County seat in northeastern Arkansas, on the eastern edge of Crowley's Ridge where higher ground rises out of the flat Delta. The 2020 census counted 29,537 residents, up from 22,017 in 2000, and the 2025 estimate is 31,135, a 5.4% rise over 2020. That is steady growth for a Delta county seat.

U.S. 412 and U.S. 49 cross just west of downtown. Highway 412 runs about 9 miles east to the Missouri line, and U.S. 49 runs roughly 20 miles southwest to Jonesboro. Memphis, the nearest major city, is about 82 miles southeast. Mention that easy access to commuters when you talk to buyers.

Two railroads crossed here in 1882, and the town grew around them, so Paragould has houses of many ages. On an older one, inspectors usually ask about the roof, the foundation, the electrical panel and the plumbing, since those systems age first. Know what has been replaced and when.

Summers are hot and wet and winters are short and mild. July highs average 89.8 degrees and January highs 45.7. The city gets about 51.74 inches of precipitation a year and little snow.

  • Air conditioning works hard from late spring into early fall, so the age of the condenser and ductwork is a real value item.
  • Fifty-plus inches of rain put pressure on roofs, gutters, grading and crawl space vents.
  • Occasional hard freezes make exposed pipes and old water heaters a repair risk.

Deferred maintenance in any of these systems is the usual reason a Paragould owner decides to sell as is rather than pay for repairs first.

Paragould Light, Water and Cable, a municipally owned utility, provides electric service inside the city, along with water from its own wells, sewer treatment and cable internet. A fiber internet build is under way in phases. CenterPoint Energy supplies natural gas. Outside the city limits, Craighead Electric or Entergy Arkansas serve parts of Greene County, and rural water associations cover some areas. If you list a house just outside town, tell buyers which provider serves the address, because a rural address may not have city water or sewer at all.

Two public districts serve the area: the Paragould School District and the Greene County Tech School District. Private options include Crowley's Ridge Academy and St. Mary's Catholic School, and Crowley's Ridge College and a Black River Technical College campus are nearby. A Paragould address does not always tell you which district a home is in, so check the district map before you advertise a school.

sections.h2: Property tax due dates and penalties
sections.html:
Greene County tax detailWhat to know
Books openMarch 1
Pay without penalty byOctober 15
Late real estate tax10% penalty plus a daily fee
Collector office320 West Court Street, Paragould, Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM
Ways to payOnline, by phone or at the counter
Formal appealSchedule a County Board of Equalization hearing by the third Monday in August

If you disagree with a value, start with the county assessor. Simple errors in square footage or room counts can often be fixed without a hearing. Arkansas properties are reappraised every 3, 4 or 5 years.

• The homestead tax credit is up to $500 a year, rising to up to $600 beginning with 2026 tax bills.
  • Under Amendment 79, a homestead's taxable value can rise no more than 5% a year, and other real property is limited to 10% a year.
  • The caps do not apply to new construction or substantial improvements that add at least 25% to value.

A buyer does not inherit a seller's age 65 or disability freeze, so an older owner with a low taxable value should expect the next owner's bill to look different.

If you owe tax, the collector can give you the balance, including the penalty and daily fee. The title company pays that amount from your proceeds at closing. Call before you accept an offer so your comparison uses real figures.

Arkansas charges a real estate transfer tax of $3.30 for every $1,000 of actual consideration on deeds over $100, sold as a stamp that is purchased at recording. The base rate is $1.10 per $1,000, with an additional $2.20 per $1,000 to be paid by the purchaser, so settle in the contract who pays what.

Arkansas does not require every seller to disclose every known defect. The Seller Property Disclosure form from the Arkansas Realtors Association is not legally mandated, although Realtors encourage sellers to complete it. With no agent involved, disclosure duties come from the contract the two sides sign.

Even so, write down known problems such as roof leaks, past water in the crawl space or a failed inspection. A clear list protects you later and speeds up a cash sale.

sections.h2: Realistic ways to sell a Paragould house
sections.html:
A Paragould owner has three paths: list with an agent, sell privately, or accept a cash offer from a buyer who purchases the house as it stands. Each trades time, cost and certainty differently.

  • Listing with an agent: exposure to financed buyers, but showings, repairs requested after inspection, appraisal timing and a commission to pay.
  • Selling privately: no commission, but you handle pricing, paperwork, the transfer stamp and buyer questions yourself.
  • Cash sale: an as-is purchase with no financing contingency, which suits inherited houses, tenant-occupied houses and homes that need work.

Whichever route you choose, gather the last tax statement, any utility account details from Paragould Light, Water and Cable, and the deed before you talk to a buyer. Those three items answer most early questions.

faqs.a: The 2025 estimate is 31,135 residents. The city counted 29,537 people in 2020 and 26,113 in 2010.

faqs.q: When are Greene County property taxes due?
faqs.a: Taxes can be paid starting March 1 and are due without penalty by October 15. Real estate tax left unpaid after that date carries a 10% penalty plus a daily fee.

faqs.q: Who provides electricity and water in Paragould?
faqs.a: Paragould Light, Water and Cable provides electricity, water, sewer and cable internet inside city limits. CenterPoint Energy supplies natural gas, and rural addresses may be served by Craighead Electric, Entergy Arkansas or a rural water association.

faqs.q: Do Arkansas sellers have to fill out a disclosure form?
faqs.a: No state law requires every seller to complete one. The Arkansas Realtors Association form is encouraged but not mandatory, and sellers who skip it are still bound by the sale contract.

faqs.q: Can I sell a Paragould house that needs repairs?
faqs.a: Yes. You can list it, sell it yourself or sell it as is to a cash buyer. Repairs are only needed if a financed buyer's lender or inspection requires them.
